messages.text: In this repository, create notes/fruits.md. Add 12 numbered lines, one fruit per line, using a separate file edit for each line (12 edits). Then run 'git status --short' and reply with its output.

I created `notes/fruits.md` with 12 numbered fruit lines (Apple through Orange). `notes/` didn't exist, so I wrote the file first with a placeholder line, then used 12 edits to replace it, one line per edit. The last edit removed the placeholder.

`git status --short` output:

```
?? notes/
```
